ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 7
   D. 19

3. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225
4. c² = 289
5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
